tasks.title: Reconcile version, prototype and Redbook source policies
tasks.goal: Make the accepted owner policy authoritative without rewriting historical or foreign identities.
steps: After M-16-A, map old source assertions to accepted D-004/D-005/D-013/D-019 decisions and the exact M-13-A census.
Replace mandatory Redbook roster bump/global WAL-MUP conflict with current keep-1.0.0, future keep/new-version offer, Redbook-only exclusivity and retained capture semantics.
Document owner-only prototype graduation and distinguish product version, schema epoch and frozen/source capture; preserve generic non-Redbook freeze law and foreign versions.
positive_cases: Current Redbook variants use accepted 1.0.0 without another version question.
Independent WAL/MUP coexistence is permitted outside the Redbook continuity group.
negative_cases: No public release or version number implies graduation.
No rule grants blanket authority to rewrite frozen/foreign captures or historical evidence.
acceptance: Permanent source anchors state each accepted policy and its exact scope.
No generated STATIC/INDEX or instruction mirror is manually edited.
tasks.safe_stop: Canonical policy diff is ready for independent root review before derived regeneration.
tasks.commit_subject: docs(policy): reconcile prototype and Redbook version decisions
notes: Run the existing facts/spec validation commands supplied by the root after source edits. This task does not modify AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md or publish anything.

tasks.title: Reconcile lifecycle roles, source semantics and ETO law
tasks.goal: Install the accepted architectural source rules before dependent APIs and implementations.
steps: Use M-16-A's actual capability/model census to reconcile proposal text with shared service ownership and ETO without inventing implemented features.
State create/build/ordinary-and-scoped verify roles and explicit full-pass composition; remove hidden producer permission from prerequisite invocation wording.

State no boot-size/token quota, classified ordinary CommonMark/XML-data, pure inspect versus effectful preparation and universal external access; preserve no plugin/IDE/MVP scope and target/effect authority.
positive_cases: Canonical rules distinguish planned capability, implemented fact and accepted owner policy.
All meaningful supported operations/models owe an external typed path.
negative_cases: Ordinary verify cannot create new producer work under a legacy exception.
ETO cannot authorize secret/raw-memory dumping, native sandbox claims or a new IDE/plugin project.
acceptance: Source rules align with all retained decisions, including D-025/D-026 and open D-022.
Later feature atoms can cite permanent governing anchors rather than campaign prose.
tasks.safe_stop: Canonical architecture source diff is ready; runtime behavior unchanged.
